title: Pregnancy emergency
summary: Heavy bleeding, severe pain or fits in pregnancy need a hospital with maternity care now.
doSteps: Help her lie on her left side.
If there is bleeding, place a clean pad or cloth and keep it, so staff can see it.
If the baby is coming, support the baby as it is born and keep it warm against the mother.
Bring her antenatal card or notes if you can.
dontSteps: Do not put anything into the vagina.
Do not pull on the baby or the cord.
Do not give food or drink.
